other_workflows.patient_companion: Linked synthetic patient SIM-COMPANION only. Added self-reported context and completed seeded published task; reload retained completed task. Clinician-approved shared note published separately from private review and visible with accurate provenance. Patient screen has no forecast controls or clinician private notes.
other_workflows.admin: Role-scoped staff list, monitored hours, audit history and pending clinical gates inspected; private invitation dialog opened and closed; no new privileged access created through browser.
other_workflows.report_feed_boundary: Final UI omits at parameter in feed mode, retains current replay cursor time in replay mode. Targeted feed Consultation summary action on SIM-REHEARSAL succeeded.
other_workflows.no_receipt_feed: Final code fixes disabled-query pending spinner and labels unconnected SIM as Synthetic research profile.

console_boundary: No application-origin console errors observed in three fresh runs. Grammarly Chrome-extension errors appeared and were excluded from application errors.
final_build: npm run build passed after final report cutoff and model lead eligibility changes; TypeScript and Vite succeeded with no chunk-size warning.
